verdict.rationale: Unreal documents exporting content via glTF, an open Khronos standard. That is a real first-party path to move scene and asset data out in an open format. The USD docs, an open-source format in Beta, describe import and editing only, and the evidence never shows bulk export of a whole project's data out of the engine's internal formats. missing for 10: documented whole-project or all-data export, open-format export for non-glTF content (Blueprints, levels, project settings), confirmed USD export, and hands-on corroboration of a complete exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Importing and Exporting Unreal Engine Content using the glTF file format
GL Transmission Format (glTF™) is an extensible, open-standard file format developed and maintained by Khronos Group.
The Universal Scene Description (USD) interchange format is an open-source format developed by Pixar
